datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data across Zambia on a monthly basis (February, June, October 2016) through field assessments and analysis. The classifications were spatially mapped to administrative units and stored in geographic formats (GeoJSON, KML) to represent acute food insecurity phases and scenarios for near-term projections.
